Messages.Author: pallando
Messages.Body:
i just saw that there is a text change in the sw version of speed of
thought. it is now a +1 stealth action which is was not before. is this a
card change that was left out in the list on the ww homepage or is it an
error?

pallando

--

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Oops.
It is an error (as one might guess when comparing Cat Burglary).

Errata (from the Design Team): Speed of Thought does not have +1 stealth
by default.
